why: the record names no degree total and no general education units

program.ge_pattern: Glendale College Associate Degree General Education
outcomes: develop an understanding of young children, and of the multiple interacting influences on children’s development and learning in order to create environments that are healthy, respectful, supportive and challenging for all children
understand and value the importance and complex characteristics of children’s families and communities
use this understanding to create respectful, reciprocal relationships that support and empower families and involve families in their children’s learning and development

articulate and understand the goals, benefits, and uses of observation and assessment, develop competence in the use of observation, documentation and assessment techniques and tools to support teaching and learning in partnership with families and other professionals
plan and implement developmentally appropriate, culturally and linguistically relevant experiences that promote and/or support development and learning for all young children
identify as a member of the early childhood profession, understand and use ethical guidelines and other professional standards related to early childhood practice.
careers: teaching in a school-age child care setting

notes: The catalog prints required courses as a bare list ('CHLDV 133, 135, 137, ...') with no units beside each course, so course units are null; the closed-list units sum to 27, matching the stated 27 units.
total_units 27 is from 'The curriculum requires completion of 27 units of Child Development courses plus 16 units of General Education'. The section serves both the certificate and the AS degree.

The 16 units of General Education (Glendale College Associate Degree GE area 9A-D) are stated as necessary for the Child Development Permit/certificates; the AS degree also requires Graduation Requirements areas 1-8. No degree total or AS GE unit figure is printed, so ge_units and degree_total are left null.

Program learning outcomes are printed once for the Child Development program as a whole (shared by all options) as a single semicolon-separated paragraph after the lead-in 'Upon completion of this program, students will'; they were split at semicolons, the final list conjunction 'and' was dropped, and line-break hyphenation and ligatures were rejoined.

Careers include those named in the shared Child Development introduction ('a career in: Infant, Toddler, and/or Preschool Education; School Age Child Care; and/or Early Childhood Administration and Supervision') plus the School-Age Care section's own 'careers in teaching in a school-age child care setting'.
